output.proposed_patch:
import re

def slugify(s):
    # Step 1: Convert to lowercase
    s = s.lower()
    # Step 2: Remove leading non-alphanumeric characters
    s = re.sub(r'^[^a-z0-9]+', '', s)
    # Step 3: Remove trailing non-alphanumeric characters
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+$', '', s)
    # Step 4: Replace runs of non-alphanumeric characters with '-'
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', s)
    return s

def test_slugify():
    assert slugify("Hello, World!") == "hello-world"
    assert slugify("  Some Text  ") == "some-text"
    assert slugify("1234!@#$") == "1234"
    assert slugify("NoSpecial-Characters") == "nospecial-characters"
    assert slugify("Trailing_Special_Characters_") == "trailing-special-characters"
    assert slugify("___Multiple___NonAlphanumerics___") == "multiple-nonalphanumerics"
    assert slugify("Leading___andTrailing") == "leading-andtrailing"
    print('ALL TESTS PASSED')

test_slugify()
